19 CFR PART 177
REVOCATION OF THREE RULING LETTERS AND
REVOCATION OF TREATMENT RELATING TO THE
TARIFF CLASSIFICATION OF CHILD-SIZED PORTABLE
TOILETS
U.S. Customs and Border Protection, Department of Homeland Se-
curity.
ACTION:  Notice of revocation of three ruling letters, and of revo-
cation of treatment relating to the tariff classiﬁcation of child-sized
portable toilets.
SUMMARY:  Pursuant to section 625(c), Tariff Act of 1930 (19 U.S.C.
§ 1625(c)), this notice advises interested parties that U.S. Customs
and Border Protection (CBP) is revoking three ruling letters.
EFFECTIVE DATE: This action is effective for merchandise
entered or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption on or after
November 15, 2026.
FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: Nicholas A.
Horne, Regulations and Rulings, Office of Trade.
SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION:
In New York Ruling Letter (NY) N319574, CBP classiﬁed child-size portable
toilets in heading 9403. The style EH63–060403 is mentioned in NY N319574.
Attachment
30 CUSTOMS BULLETIN AND DECISIONS, VOL. 60, N O. 28, SEPTEMBER 16, 2026[[page 2]]
HQ H336925
September 1, 2026
OT:RR:CTF:CPMMA H336925 NAH
RE: Revocation of NY N319574, NY M83046, and NY L83440; Tariff classi-
ﬁcation of child-sized portable toilets from China.
DEAR MS. LEVITT,
This letter is in reference to New York Ruling Letter (NY) N319574.
For the reasons set forth below, CBP hereby revokes NY N319574.
EFFECT ON OTHER RULINGS:
NY N319574, dated June 2, 2021, is hereby revoked.
NY M83046, dated May 16, 2006, is hereby revoked.
NY L83440, dated April 18, 2005, is hereby revoked.
Sincerely,

PROPOSED REVOCATION OF FIVE RULING LETTERS AND
PROPOSED REVOCATION OF TREATMENT RELATING TO THE
TARIFF CLASSIFICATION OF PERSONAL SOUND
AMPLIFIERS
AGENCY: U.S. Customs and Border Protection, Department of
Homeland Security.
ACTION: Notice of proposed revocation of five ruling letters and
proposed revocation of treatment relating to the tariff classiﬁcation of
personal sound ampliﬁers.
SUMMARY: CBP intends to revoke five ruling letters.
DATE: Comments must be received on or before September 13,
2024.
FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: Regulations and Rulings.

RE: Revocation of HQ 966570; forged titanium billets

HQ H313006
RE: Revocation of NY N283085, NY N166443, NY N025447, NY D80822 and HQ
